name: Forbidden Knowledge
label: Quest
description: Yagyin's Digest is handed over with a warning to guard it well from unfriendly hands. Theldurin the Lost is the one to carry it to.
intro: Yagyin's Digest is handed over with a warning to guard it well from unfriendly hands. Theldurin the Lost is the one to carry it to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have the digest for you, friend. I need not tell you to take great care with it. And to keep it far from unfriendly hands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ho! You were gone a long time. Did you get the digest?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got it! Oh, hope glimmers!
Your efforts may yet save us, friend. A monument they should make of you! A shrine they should build! May your name be praised until your grandchildren have grandchildren!
Unless...THEY are freed and rise to the surface. If that happens then you can forget about children.
If THEY are freed, then we're all worm food.
